tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.16.38;
father of: Shimri (H8113I), Hilkiah (H2518J), Tebaliah (H2882), Zechariah (H2148F)
§ Hosah = "refuge"
1) a Levitical doorkeeper of the temple
2) a place in Asher

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Chosah, an Israelite; also a place in Palestine
